_metadata.description: Accept a program, execute it in its session, return only what it materializes, and retain the corpus. Owns handles, inference and delegation callables, and provenance.

requirements.title: Handle-based results
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST return operation results as in-kernel handles whose default representation is bounded, and MUST require an explicit materialization call before result data enters the submitter's output.

validation.notes: Target `kernel/tests/test_handles.py::test_default_repr_is_bounded` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). A handle's default representation is bounded regardless of underlying row count or payload size.

Target `kernel/tests/test_handles.py::test_materialization_is_explicit` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). Row data reaches program output only through an explicit materialization call, never via default repr.

Target `kernel/tests/test_handles.py::test_filter_and_aggregate_run_in_kernel` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). Filter, count, and group operations resolve in-kernel without materializing the source collection.

Target `api/internal/programs/scaling_test.go::TestKernelAgentBytesStayBoundedAcrossResultSizes` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). A real kernel executes the same bounded query against result sets differing by four orders of magnitude; post-truncation agent-facing bytes remain in a constant band while explicitly materialized output exceeds that band.

requirements.title: Bounded asynchronous execution
requirements.description: When work cannot complete within the synchronous response budget, the Program Runtime MUST return a durable program identifier and provide one bounded wait operation that reports either terminal completion or the current non-terminal state without client polling.

validation.notes: The API wait path wakes on the terminal transition instead of discovering completion through a polling interval.
A bounded wait returns the current program and an explicit non-terminal result when its deadline expires.
The public programs wait command is a governed read bound to ProgramService.WaitForProgram through the standard proto-list primitive.

requirements.title: Typed inference bindings
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD expose classify, extract, and judge operations resolved through ai-gateway, so a program performs bounded typed inference without spawning a delegated agent run.

validation.notes: Target `kernel/tests/test_execution_contract.py` plus the live program-runtime inference example. The kernel facade selects classify.fast, extract.structured, judge.default, or write.default and dispatches through the governed ai-gateway InferenceService.Run binding. Sampling is carried only for the overridable write role, and an absent temperature stays absent so the role default applies; provider/schema failures remain typed and bounded.

The former promotion waiver is retired. Native provider schema constraints and ai-gateway local schema validation are covered by the inference repository tests; live execution is additionally validated when the provider resource is available.

requirements.title: Delegated agent runs from a program
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD let a program spawn an agent-manager run and collect its evidence, so unbounded agentic work stays distinguishable from bounded inference.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/delegation_test.go::TestSpawnsAgentManagerRunAndCollectsEvidence` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-003]). A program spawns a real run and collects its evidence, keeping unbounded agentic work distinct from bounded inference.

requirements.title: Queryable program corpus
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD retain submitted program source and failure detail as a queryable corpus so recurring failure shapes are derivable mechanically.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/service_test.go::TestRetainsProgramSourceAndFailureDetail` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-006]). Submitted source and failure detail are retained and queryable after the session ends.

Target `api/internal/programs/service_test.go::TestRecurringFailureShapesAreDerivable` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-006]). Repeated failures sharing a shape are countable mechanically, without an inference call.

requirements.title: Program provenance
requirements.description: The Program Runtime SHOULD record whether a program was submitted by an agent or by a human operator, and SHOULD exclude operator-submitted programs from corpus mining by default.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/programs/service_test.go::TestSubmissionRecordsProvenance` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-008]). Every submission carries an agent or operator provenance; neither is inferred silently.

Target `api/internal/programs/service_test.go::TestMiningExcludesOperatorProgramsByDefault` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-008]). A corpus query for recurring shapes omits operator-submitted programs unless they are explicitly included.

requirements.title: Program corpus mining
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MAY analyze recurring program shapes in the corpus and propose them as skill or action candidates with their call sites as evidence.

validation.notes: No validation target exists: MineFailures reports recurring failure shapes, but no scenario-owned surface proposes skill or action candidates with call-site evidence.

Status correction (2026-08-11): this remains planned because the scenario does not yet propose recurring shapes as skill/action candidates or attach call sites. The prerequisite corpus is now durable SQLite, and the new typed failure/refusal/unresolved projections provide evidence for a future consumer; those projections do not claim the candidate-generation requirement is complete.

requirements.title: Versioned reusable program library
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST keep reusable programs versioned, explicitly promoted, retention-safe, and frozen per session before exposing them through vrooli.lib.

validation.notes: API library and retention tests prove copy-on-promote, failed-source rejection, current-version stamping, and preservation of a promoted source while an unpromoted program is deleted.
Live session executed a promoted probe through vrooli.lib with a frozen library_version stamp; program-runtime.library and program-runtime.bindings were both active production Search Hub providers.
